look: Chalk geometry: a dark maths-explainer look (3Blue1Brown-style): clean vector dots, arrows and grids drawn in glowing strokes on a dark ground, shapes morphing smoothly, short serif captions. Same look as the Poisson, Metrics and IER films of this series.

scenes.name: MeshAnything
scenes.desc: Title over our real MeshAnything mesh turning slowly.

scenes.name: Two kinds of mesh
scenes.desc: The same outline drawn with many tiny pieces and with a few well-placed ones.

scenes.name: On our scan
scenes.desc: Our Poisson mesh with a million triangles beside MeshAnything with 1,435.

scenes.name: How a language model writes
scenes.desc: A sentence grows one token at a time, each picked from scored options.

scenes.name: Corners into numbers
scenes.desc: A box cut into 128 steps; a corner snaps to whole numbers; a triangle becomes nine.

scenes.name: A fixed order
scenes.desc: Corners sorted and numbered so one mesh always gives one sentence.

scenes.name: Share the edge
scenes.desc: Neighbouring triangles reuse an edge, so each new one costs three numbers, not nine.

scenes.name: Where the shape comes in
scenes.desc: Dots become 257 shape tokens that prompt the transformer.

scenes.name: Watch it write
scenes.desc: Our real mesh drawn triangle by triangle in the order the model wrote it.

scenes.name: Part 1 in one line
scenes.desc: The pipeline in five boxes, and what Part 2 covers.
